entry.title: Kuressaare Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Two inspected aerial pictures confirm the square stone convent, open court, inward-sloping red roofs, massive Sturvolt and slender Tall Hermann. Standard viewer PMTiles and cached building outline set location and signed tower/gate orientation. The flat site varies by less than1m at sampled corners; a reconstructed0.6m working rise and bounded foundation skirts clear that coarse surface. Anchor 22.479324007,58.246897902; heading -0.563076620916; standard PMTiles datum 9.787413303227948m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
